BrochureContent.Content:
Very private detached house located on a quiet cul de sac road and only 12 minute walk to to picturesque village of Sneem.

Accommodation briefly comprises of entrance hall, living room, kitchen, dining room, bedroom, bathroom, utility and second bedroom/office on the ground floor.
The first floor has two further bedrooms (one en-suite) and bathroom.

Attached to the house is small garage/shed.

The house is perched on a site of just under 0.5 of an acre with lawn area to rear and side.

OFCH throughout and open fore in main living room.

Mains water and septic tank service the property.

The house is in very good condition throughout.
